source.text: 6.3 Where the Buyer places a single Purchase Order for twenty (20) or more units of Equipment, the Vendor shall allow the Buyer a discount of 3% on the price of that Purchase Order.
The Buyer shall settle each invoice that is correct and undisputed in full within fifteen (15) days of the date appearing on that invoice
